svg.text: SPACEGUIDANCE STAGE EX // VIEWER-MATCHED 6-DoF DELTA FIGHTER SCHEMATIC
OUTWARD EXHAUST & REACTION THRUST TOPOLOGY (NEWTON'S 3RD LAW)

g.text: VIEW A: HORIZONTAL PLANE (XY TOP VIEW // Z = 0)
VIEW B: VERTICAL ELEVATION (XZ SIDE VIEW // Y = 0)
T8 + T11 = Max Pitch Down (-50 N·m) | T9 + T10 = Max Pitch Up (+50 N·m)
T8 + T10 = Pure Down (-40 N) | T9 + T11 = Pure Up (+40 N)
VISUAL CONVENTION & NEWTON'S 3RD LAW OF ACTION-REACTION
• Orange Plume (Exhaust): Hot gas ejection direction. Always expelled outward into cold vacuum space.
• Colored Arrow (Reaction Thrust): Force acting on vehicle (F_thrust = -F_exhaust), directly opposite to plume.
• Outward gas ejection prevents thermal plume impingement on vehicle hull and delivers pure reaction thrust.
• Triad Mounting: Wheel X (Roll/Purple, +X), Wheel Y (Pitch/Cyan, +Y), Wheel Z (Yaw/Magenta, +Z)
• Inertia: Iw = 0.05 kg·m² | Limit: ±6,000 RPM | Registers: 0x2C (RW_Z), 0x98 (RW_X), 0x9C (RW_Y)
• Thruster Cube Colors: Orange = Healthy (0x0FFF) | Red = Damaged / Dead Nozzle
• Detumble Bonus: Up to +3,000 pts | Center Bullseye Bonus (r ≤ 1.0m): +2,500 pts
• Leak Rate: -0.15 %/s | Grade S: ≥ 8,000 pts (Elite Astronaut Certification)
